title: John Vaske Joins Evercore as Senior Managing Director in the Chemicals Investment Banking Group
summary: Evercore announced today that John Vaske has joined the firm as a senior managing director in its chemicals investment banking group. He will be based in New York.
body_markdown: Evercore announced today that John Vaske has joined the firm as a senior managing director in its chemicals investment banking group. He will be based in New York.
